pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-polygonal dark regions characterized by softened edge gradients and low-contrast boundaries due to significant sensor noise and motion blur. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with smaller, more condensed geometries visible on the neck transitioning to larger, more elongated shapes on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light pelage pathways forming a topological web. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-point intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, appearing widest at junction nodes and narrowing along the segments separating patches.
